newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan one-month NCDs average yield at 6.168 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan one-month NCDs average yield at 6.168 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank issued T$8 billion in one-month negotiable certificates of deposit on Tuesday at an average yield of 6.168 percent, a central bank official said.
The range of the bids was between 6.080 and 6.280 percent.
The central bank has said its recent series of NCD issues aimed to absorb the banking system's extra money, not to dampen stock market turnover as many analysts have asserted.
